issue_context.title: http: make early hints implementation more generic
issue_context.body:
In https://github.com/nodejs/node/pull/44180, we thought that the "early hints" implementation is not complete as it landed.

We need to fix it either as:

```js
response.writeEarlyHints({
  link: 'your link header',
  x-trace-id: 'id for diagnostics'
})
```

or

```js
response.writeInfomation(103, "Early Hints", {
  link: 'your link header',
  x-trace-id: 'id for diagnostics'
})
```
comments: I'm working on this task, and will open a pull request soon.

review_comments: This code refers to Link header having a valid format. Well I was thinking the same thing, until I read the spec. You can find the reference in here: https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc8297#section-2
I cant see any abnf format of the Link. Only some examples. There is no anchor or title attribute in the spec

Spec is refering with those but should be extended to all link tag attributes for example: https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Element/link

`crossorigin` is a requirement to me.

You're right! Thanks for the feedback. Well, I found the correct HTML standard. It seems all of [these attributes](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/semantics.html#the-link-element) should be supported. @mcollina can you verify?
not sure, what's the question? The issue in question is about the API, not the regexp. If the regexp is not sufficient, maybe open a new issue?
Well I'll open a new pull request for the regexp change.
I opened another pull-request to discuss which attributes are important to support & add missing ones: https://github.com/nodejs/node/pull/44874
